title: Known agents resolve to their A2A endpoint without an override file
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. A registry of well-known agents and endpoints replaces hand-written adapter JSON for the common cases. Tests zc_a2a_registry_*.
